chain.title: Shelves From the Shallows
chain.desc: Use Seashelves as one route beyond a normal enchanting setup. Check Eterna, Quanta and Arcana in the table interface; the displayed maximum is as important as the total supplied by your shelves.

chain.title: Bookcases Cast in Fire
chain.desc: Use Hellshelves as the Nether-resource alternative to Seashelves. Choose the route that matches your supplies rather than assuming both starter shelf families are compulsory.

chain.title: Not Merely a Diamond
chain.desc: Collect Apothic Gems from appropriate loot and encounters. Read the socket bonuses and equipment restrictions before inserting a valuable gem into gear.

chain.title: Torn From the Silence
chain.desc: Prepare carefully before hunting the Warden for a tendril. This is a combat-resource branch for advanced shelves, not a reason to walk into the encounter with only enchanting equipment.

chain.title: Measure the Enchanting Room
chain.desc: Build a working enchanting setup that meets an early shelf-infusion recipe. Use either suitable Seashelves or Hellshelves, check the displayed statistics, and confirm after completing an infusion. This checkpoint does not require both starter shelf families.

chain.title: Steeped in Sea Magic
chain.desc: Meet the infusion recipe's enchanting requirements and infuse a Seashelf. Replace selected starter shelves with the infused version, then recheck the table's available level range.

chain.title: Steeped in Hellfire
chain.desc: Infuse a Hellshelf using the required enchanting setup. The infused shelf raises the ceiling for later enchanting projects and can support either a utility shelf branch or deeper progression.

chain.title: Ledger of Every Enchantment
chain.desc: Store enchanted books in the Enchantment Library and try extracting a useful enchantment. This is an organisation branch alongside shelf progression, so keep improving the table while the library accumulates options.

chain.title: Crushed Under the Anvil
chain.desc: Turn an unwanted gem into Gem Dust using the method shown in the Chronicle of Shadows. Save useful gems; dust supports several crafting benches, but destroying your best gem is not the only way to progress.

chain.title: Deepslate That Has Not Woken
chain.desc: Deepslate around a Book, craftable once you hold a level 60 table; it is only the unfinished shell of a Deepshelf.

chain.title: A Spyglass on the Enchantment
chain.desc: Add a Sightshelf when you want more information about a prospective enchantment. Its purpose is better clues; it does not replace the shelves that supply your required enchanting statistics.

chain.title: Bending Chance Toward You
chain.desc: Use a Rectifier to make the effect of Quanta more favourable. Check the statistics together instead of increasing Quanta without understanding its effect on the roll.

chain.title: Breaking Down the Spoils
chain.desc: Salvage unwanted affix equipment into its rarity materials. Check the input carefully: the gear is destroyed, while the resulting material supports reforging and gem upgrades.

chain.title: Slate Threaded With Dust
chain.desc: Deepslate ringed with Gem Dust; the plate every Sigil is stamped from.

chain.title: Roused From the Deepslate
chain.desc: Infuse Dormant Deepshelves once your table meets the stated requirements. Rebalance the complete setup after replacing shelves, since additional power can also change Quanta and Arcana.

chain.title: The Lapidary's Bench
chain.desc: Upgrade a gem at the Gem Cutting Table with the required matching materials. Compare the resulting bonus before spending scarce gems and rarity materials on another upgrade.

chain.title: Rolling the Dice Again
chain.desc: Use Gem Dust and suitable rarity materials to reforge a piece of equipment. Inspect the available costs and outcomes; this gear branch can develop independently of the late enchanting shelves.

chain.title: Where the Cursed Books Live
chain.desc: A Deepshelf variant that makes treasure enchantments, curses included, appear in the enchanting table.

chain.title: Sculk That Answers Back
chain.desc: Craft the advanced sculk shelf and inspect the table statistics it supplies. Use it to reach the requirements for Infused Dragon's Breath rather than building shelves without measuring the result.

chain.title: Focusing a Nether Star
chain.desc: Use the Augmenting Table to improve or reroll individual affixes on suitable equipment. Read the cost and current affix carefully so the change strengthens the build you are using.

chain.title: Distilled Dragon's Breath
chain.desc: Bring Dragon's Breath to an enchanting setup that meets its infusion recipe. The infused result starts the Endshelf branch.

chain.title: Reforging Without Limit
chain.desc: Upgrade your reforging workshop for higher-rarity equipment. Bring the corresponding salvage materials and enough experience before rerolling the gear you intend to keep.

chain.title: End Stone and Pearl
chain.desc: End Stone Bricks, an Ender Pearl, a bookshelf and Infused Breath; max eterna climbs to 45.

chain.title: Pearlescent Archive
chain.desc: The upgraded Endshelf, worth 5 eterna with 7.5 quanta and arcana apiece, and the backbone of a level 90 table.

chain.title: One Shelf, Ten Levels
chain.desc: Use the Dragon Head and the remaining listed materials to make a Draconic Endshelf. Finish by checking the whole table setup; the final shelf matters because of the statistics it helps your arrangement reach.

coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
